result.title: Same-State Pairs Make One JEPA Proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis Vacuous
result.summary: In a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), the JEPA proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) assumes that every observation determines the world state and that a spectral gap makes minimizers unique up to rotation. Under the hard-whitening population objective, same-state positive pairs make the induced world kernel the identity: every centered whitened state function is a global minimizer, and, when $d_z-1\ge 2k$, two minimizers can have best-rotation squared residual $2k$. The uniqueness claim is conditional; for $k<d_z-1$, where $d_z$ is the number of world states, this limit makes its premise unsatisfiable, so the claim has no content there. The experiments that motivate it leave the assumption: a caption sees only part of an image, and the paper states no experiment meets its hypotheses exactly. The theorem does not reach those experiments, and for $k<d_z-1$ its idealized same-state limit is vacuous. One of the paper's four quantitative results survives: a gap-free lower bound. Its bound vanishes only at perfect scene-explained fraction; it bounds alignment error but cannot certify good-view alignment. A canonical frame is determined only up to a rotation and a latent permutation. Paired samples fix the relative frame at effective rank $k$; a global rotation remains. Component semantics fix the relative permutation only up to signs; value anchors fix it once the mixing frame is pinned. A resource--gauge ledger records which resource fixes which gauge.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从理论层面反驳 JEPA 对「柏拉图表示假说」的证明：在硬白化目标下，same-state 正对使世界核成为恒等，任意中心化白化状态函数都是全局最优解，因此当世界状态数 k 小于 d_z−1 时唯一性命题前提不可满足而变得空泛，并进一步讨论规范框架只能确定到旋转与潜在置换，以及何种资源固定何种规范。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心是 latent 表示的可辨识性与规范自由度（旋转、置换、锚点），可能可供核查「比较 latent 相似度或声称表示对齐时，规范选择是否会伪装成内容差异」这一问题，但不涉及 VLM 推理与视觉证据使用。
